parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the need to emulate Python jsonschema validation, Python-style output, manual argv parsing, ESM .mjs files, no external dependencies, and output under /output.

parallel.implementation: No implementation files were written. The run executed many test2_executable probes and then checked Node availability, stopping before code generation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: There was no integration or delivery step. Artifact validation found an empty artifact directory and expected test2.mjs was absent.
parallel.verification: The run used the Python executable for black-box discovery but performed no Node-side implementation verification because no Node files existed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The entire deliverable remained unfinished: no test2.mjs, no library modules, no final response, and no accepted solution.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same migration constraints, including ESM, .mjs suffixes, manual --a/--b parsing, no external libraries, and black-box behavior matching.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial actor self-owned probing, module design, code writing, edits, planned testing, and delivery without subagents or cross-agent contracts.
serial.implementation: It wrote a broad hand-coded implementation split across pyrepr, pyjson, pyops, keywords, validator, tracebacks, argparse, and test2.mjs, then applied small edits.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It created the expected entry file and supporting lib modules in /output, and artifact validation copied those files successfully.
serial.verification: It ran many Python executable probes but was canceled before its pending differential-test phase and left no visible successful Node/evaluator-aligned local verification.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Although an artifact existed, official evaluation still failed 0/157; the included evidence does not expose individual testcase failures, only that the implementation attempt was not accepted.
